name: Liv
verdict: Being rated: a maintainer decides whether the US customs Withhold Release Order against Giant counts as a forced-labour finding.
note: Women's bike brand of Giant and co-title sponsor of Liv AlUla Jayco (The Inner Ring, 2026-08-05, 'Giant’s women’s brand Liv'). Giant Group's corporate site lists Liv among its product brands and shows the TPE: 9921 ticker (giantgroup-cycling.com, opened 2026-10-03). Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. In September 2025 US Customs and Border Protection issued a Withhold Release Order against Giant Manufacturing's Taiwan-made bicycles, parts and accessories, on information that reasonably indicates forced labour (claim giant-manufacturing-wro-2025; CBP's release says its investigation identified ILO forced-labour indicators including debt bondage and withholding of wages). If that counts as a regulator finding of forced labour by the company, the tier is concern. Giant Manufacturing's large shareholders are not traced in the claims.
